title: A library’s portable planetarium afternoon
titleZh: 圖書館行動天象館午後活動
passage:
DOCUMENT 1 — Library event desk rules
You may reserve one full show per card. Walk-in places are offered only after ticket holders have entered. A companion can sit beside you at any full show, but you must reserve two adjacent seats. All full shows use a projected night sky; the orientation tour is not a full show and can be added to either show booking.

If you want the dome lights left on until you find your seat, choose the session marked “lights on for entry.” At other sessions the lights go down before entry. The optional orientation tour shows where the doors are while the dome is bright; it does not change how lights are used at any show. A printed floor plan is yours to keep. With a raised-line floor plan, you can feel the edges and doorways, but that version is lent for the visit and must be brought back to the help desk.

DOCUMENT 2 — Saturday board
1:40 Orientation tour | 15 minutes | Meet at coat hooks
2:00 City Winter Sky | 25 minutes | lights down for entry
2:40 City Winter Sky | 25 minutes | lights on for entry
3:20 City Winter Sky | 25 minutes | lights down for entry

Seats 6 and 7 together are still free at 2:40; only seats 2 and 9 are left at 2:00. The later 3:20 show has a row of open seats. The help desk closes at 3:45.

DOCUMENT 3 — Message between neighbors
I’ll bring Pema on Saturday. We want to sit together and she needs the lights up while we find the seats. I have one library card; I can reserve a place for each of us at the same show. We can arrive by 1:35 and she would like to see the doors first. We need to be outside the dome by 3:10 for our bus. Pema wants to try the raised-line floor plan but won’t be back at the library next week.
passageZh:
文件一｜圖書館活動櫃台規則
每張借閱證可預約一場完整放映。有票的觀眾全進場後，才開放現場候補。同伴可在任何完整放映與你並坐，但須預約兩個相鄰座位。所有完整放映都用投影呈現夜空；場地導覽不算完整放映，可加選在任一場次的預約中。

若想在找到座位前保持圓頂場內照明，請選標為「入場時開燈」的場次。其他場次會在入場前調暗燈光。可選的場地導覽會在場內明亮時指示門的位置，但不會改變任何放映場次的照明安排。一般紙本平面圖可留用。凸線平面圖能以觸摸辨認邊緣和門口，但僅限參觀期間借用，須還到服務櫃台。

文件二｜星期六活動表
1:40 場地導覽｜15 分鐘｜在掛衣鉤旁集合
2:00 冬季城市星空｜25 分鐘｜入場時調暗燈光
2:40 冬季城市星空｜25 分鐘｜入場時開燈
3:20 冬季城市星空｜25 分鐘｜入場時調暗燈光

2:40 場相鄰的 6、7 號座位仍有空；2:00 場只剩 2、9 號座位。較晚的 3:20 場有一整排空位。服務櫃台 3:45 關閉。

文件三｜鄰居之間的訊息
星期六我會帶佩瑪去。我們想坐在一起；找座位時，她需要保持照明。我有一張借閱證，可以在同一場為我們各訂一個座位。我們能在 1:35 前抵達，她想先看門的位置。我們得在 3:10 前走出圓頂場館搭公車。佩瑪想試用凸線平面圖，下星期卻不會再來圖書館。
